meta.title: Codex overload recovery
meta.description: Recognizes the known Codex server-overload error and enables native same-step request retries. Keeps your provider’s retry limits, cancellation and standard retry feedback; does not rerun tools or add prompts. Other PI_AI_ERROR failures are unchanged. Inspect the active policy with autorecovery_status. Already-closed turns and external CLI subagents are not automatically resumed.
